description: Codex hooks for Gauntlet (Codex reads this file through .codex-plugin/plugin.json; Claude Code reads hooks.json). Each event is told to the local Gauntlet agent so the watch lists the Codex session, buzzes when a turn ends or asks for permission, and, while you are away from the PC with a watch connected, a permission waits up to 2 minutes for Allow or Deny from the watch and a finished turn waits up to 2 minutes for a reply from the watch, which Codex runs as the next prompt. Codex substitutes ${PLUGIN_ROOT} in the command; it runs through $SHELL -lc, or cmd.exe /C on Windows (commandWindows). Codex escapes quotes as \" there, which cmd.exe reads literally, so commandWindows quotes nothing: cd /d takes a path with spaces as is. Codex skips these until you trust them in /hooks, and again after they change. Codex escapes quotes when it hands commandWindows to cmd.exe, which then reads them literally, so commandWindows quotes nothing: cd /d takes a path with spaces as it is. Codex escapes quotes when it hands commandWindows to cmd.exe, which then reads them literally, so commandWindows quotes nothing: cd /d takes a path with spaces as it is.
